title: Billing Method Statement: Final Electricity Allowance and Final Electricity Overage Charge
content:
# Final Electricity Allowance and Overage — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Final electricity allowance.** The final electricity allowance of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account is the package's monthly electricity allowance times the proration days over the days in period recorded on the account's latest package fee line, rounded to 3 decimals. Electricity allowances of every period other than the final period of an account in final billing remain prorated for a partial month by days of responsibility over the actual days of the period, to 3 decimals.

**Final electricity overage.** The final electricity overage is the electricity usage recorded on the account's latest electricity read, the service end read, less the final electricity allowance, never below zero, rounded to 3 decimals; the line records it as its usage.

**Charge.** The final electricity overage line bills the final electricity overage times the package's electricity rate per kWh, times the package overage rate multiplier, the product rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| proration days, days in period | the account's latest package fee line |
| electricity usage | the latest electricity read on the account, which is the service end read |
| monthly electricity allowance, electricity rate, overage multiplier | the All-Inclusive Utility Package figures |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures: monthly allowance 600 kWh, rate $0.15 per kWh, multiplier 1.00 — illustrative, not the package's tariff)

The latest package fee line records 12 proration days over 30 days in period; the service end electricity read records 410.000 kWh.

- Final electricity allowance: 600 times 12 divided by 30 is 240.000 kWh.
- Final electricity overage: 410.000 less 240.000 is 170.000 kWh.
- Charge: 170.000 times $0.15 times 1.00 is $25.50.

*Rounding case (hypothetical):* 7 proration days over 30 on a 600 kWh allowance give 140.000 kWh; with a service end read of 333.333 kWh the overage is 193.333 kWh, and at $0.15 the charge is $28.99995, which is $29.00 at the end.
